bib.title: LAION-5B: An open large-scale dataset for training next generation image-text models
bib.venue: preprint (arXiv:2210.08402v1; datasheet mentions NeurIPS ethics review)

question: Can an openly released dataset of billions of CLIP-filtered web image-text pairs support training of CLIP-class and text-to-image models, and what are its safety and ethics limits?
hypothesis: A public dataset of roughly CLIP-WIT scale or larger lets open models match OpenAI CLIP, and larger data scale improves zero-shot transfer given enough compute.
contributions: LAION-5B: 5.85B CLIP-filtered image-text pairs (2.32B English, 2.26B multilingual, 1.27B unknown language)
Open pipeline code, kNN indices, web UI, NSFW/watermark/Q16 tags
Open reproduction of CLIP ViT-B/32, B/16, B/16+, L/14 on LAION-400M and B/32, L/14 on LAION-2B-en
Fine-tuning of GLIDE (LAIONIDE) and use for Stable Diffusion

method.summary: Image-text pairs are extracted from Common Crawl alt-text, language-detected, downloaded, and kept if CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine similarity exceeds 0.28 (English) or 0.26 (other). Safety tags (NSFW, watermark, Q16) are attached rather than removed. CLIP models are retrained with OpenCLIP on LAION-400M and LAION-2B-en to validate, and GLIDE is fine-tuned on LAION.
method.task: dataset construction and validation (contrastive image-text pretraining, text-to-image fine-tuning)

datasets.name: LAION-5B
datasets.source: Common Crawl alt-text, URLs only; metadata CC-BY-4.0, no ownership of image/text copyright
datasets.preprocessing: CLD3 language detection; removed <5 characters text, <5 KB image, malicious/large/redundant images; CLIP ViT-B/32 (multilingual CLIP for non-English) similarity >=0.28 English, >=0.26 other; removed ~90% of ~50B images; data filtered Sep 2021 to Jan 2022

datasets.name: LAION-Aesthetic / LAION-High-Resolution
datasets.preprocessing: aesthetic by linear estimator on CLIP

datasets.name: NSFW classifier training set
datasets.split: test: 1000 images per category, manually checked
datasets.source: retrieved from LAION-400M by CLIP proximity to keywords, plus Wikiart and Danbooru

models.name: LAIONIDE (GLIDE fine-tune)
models.architecture: GLIDE 64px base, unmodified OpenAI upsampler to 256

other.training_subsets: 237k steps 256x256 LAION-2B-en; 194k steps 512x512 laion-high-resolution; 515k steps 512x512 laion-improved-aesthetics; 390k steps same with 10% text-conditioning drop

training.objective: InfoNCE (CLIP contrastive) for CLIP; GLIDE diffusion fine-tune with captions replaced by unconditional token 20% of time
training.hardware: 128 to 400 NVIDIA A100 on JUWELS Booster (B/32 400M 128, B/32 2B 112, B/16 176, B/16+ 224, L/14 400); LAIONIDE-v1 on RTX 2070 Super batch 1, v2 on 8xA100

other.LAIONIDE-v2: ~25M shuffled pairs from LAION-2B, filtered NSFW/LIKELY, non-en, aspect ratio >1.3 or <0.8, smallest side <256, slur substring list
other.LAIONIDE-v3: ~1M pairs mixing MS-COCO, Visual Genome, Open Images localized annotations, LAION-5B to reduce watermarks

inference.prompting: zero-shot classification: class embedding is mean over prompt templates from prior works, argmax cosine similarity

other.sampler: pseudo linear multi-step diffusion sampling (Liu et al.) for LAIONIDE

metrics.name: zero-shot top-1
metrics.definition: class chosen by largest cosine similarity

eval.protocol: single runs, no seeds or intervals reported; GLIDE comparison is qualitative (web demo)

availability.code: github LAION-AI/LAION-5B-WatermarkDetection, CLIP-based-NSFW-Detector, rom1504/img2dataset, clip-retrieval, open_clip
availability.data: metadata on Hugging Face (URLs and alt-text, CC-BY-4.0); images not redistributed

limits: Authors: not a finished data product; academic use only; no deployed systems without bias investigation.
Filtering used CLIP ViT-B/32 only; larger CLIP not tried; authors hypothesise ViT-L/14 filtering would be cleaner (untested).
Test set overlap with Common Crawl not measured; de-duplication deferred.
Alt-text is often SEO spam or keyword lists (Birhane et al.).
Safety/watermark classifiers are imperfect; no recall figure is given for watermark or Q16.
GLIDE fine-tune is judged qualitatively via a web demo, no FID or human study; Stable Diffusion training listed but not evaluated here.
Single runs, no seeds or error bars.

Dataset is URLs: link rot; copyright of images and text not owned; consent absent (datasheet Q31). The paper was written before later findings about illegal content in the dataset, which it does not discuss (reader note, not in the paper).
Training precision, total compute and LAION-80M details not given.
